# Tesla Magnetic Generator

> A DIY resource for building magnetic generators and going off-grid, based on Nikola Tesla's designs. Written by Jake Mercer, a DIY enthusiast and off-grid homeowner in rural Colorado.

## About

Jake Mercer is a DIY enthusiast who has built four magnetic generators and gone fully off-grid. This site covers the practical experience of building and running magnetic generators, comparisons with solar power, and honest answers to common questions about "free energy" devices.
